annotations.title: Medicare IRMAA tier for a MAGI

description: Returns the Medicare IRMAA tier a MAGI sets: the official 2026 and 2027 tiers (from 2024 and 2025 MAGI, CMS's tables) and the 2028 tier (from 2026 MAGI) on the table as QuantCalc projects it, labelled projected; with each the monthly Part B and Part D surcharge per person, the annual total for the people on Medicare, and the distance to the next tier. Reads the same CMS tables as the website's IRMAA calculator.

both_spouses_on_medicare.description: Joint return only: both spouses are on Medicare (the surcharge is per person). Default true, stated.

cpi_assumption_percent.description: The CPI-U assumption of the projected 2028 floors and amounts (the amounts grown from CMS's 2027 table): 2.0 (default, the rate the website's IRMAA tools use), 2.5, 3.0. The 2027 tiers do not depend on it: they are CMS's published table, as on /irmaa-brackets-2027/.

filing_status.description: Filing status: single, married filing jointly (mfj), married filing separately (mfs) or head of household (hoh).

magi.description: Modified AGI (AGI plus tax-exempt interest) of the 2024 return, which sets the 2026 premiums; also used for 2025 and 2026 unless they are given.

magi_2025.description: 2025 MAGI, which sets the 2027 premiums. Default: magi.

magi_2026.description: 2026 MAGI, which sets the 2028 premiums. Default: magi.
